headline: Eli Lilly (LLY) Stock Gets Fair Value Bump As Analysts Lift Targets On GLP1 Outlook
summary: Analysts have been lifting Eli Lilly price targets, with recent valuation work for the stock pointing to fair value of US$1,270.37 compared with the prior US$1,243.43 anchor. The shift lines up with a more constructive Wall Street stance as firms reassess the obesity and diabetes portfolio, retatrutide data, and Q2 earnings setup, with bullish targets clustering between roughly US$1,232 and US$1,600.
